\[
A=(0,0),\quad B=(2,3),\quad C=(5,4),\quad D=(3,1).

\[
[\triangle ABC]
=\frac12\left|2\cdot4-3\cdot5\right|
=\frac72.
\]

For \(\triangle ACD\),

\[
[\triangle ACD]
=\frac12\left|5\cdot1-4\cdot3\right|
=\frac72.
\]

Therefore, the shaded area is

\[
\frac72+\frac72=7.
\]
